placements.title: New hires move through one ratified, named path, not ad hoc guidance
placements.frame: What keeps the Pallasine checklist the single authoritative onboarding path rather than one option among several, as new envelopes report on it?
placements.why: src-1 states a universal mandate ('every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist') naming three concrete components (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) — a subject future onboarding envelopes will keep feeding, not a one-time fact. src-2 supplies the checklist's provenance ('replaced the old wiki page last quarter'), grounding the mandate's standing in continuity over a prior regime rather than reporting an isolated event. Together they name a durable organizational theme — the onboarding path's authority and its succession — that passes the narrative grain test; no existing leaf exists yet to hold it (graph structure supplied is empty), so it is minted under the newly-minted Organization strata rather than left standalone.
